description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies `npkill` as the tool. 2. Agent runs `npkill --target .next --dry-run --directory /workspace/projects` and redirects/tees the output to `cleanup_preview.txt` in /workspace. This requires knowing both `--target .next` (not the default node_modules) and `--dry-run` and `--directory`. 3. Agent then runs `npkill --target .next --delete-all --yes --directory /workspace/projects` to non-interactively delete all .next folders ONLY within /workspace/projects. The key proprietary traps are: (a) using `--target .next` instead of the default node_modules target, (b) using `--yes` alongside `--delete-all` for non-interactive automation, (c) using `--directory /workspace/projects` to scope the scan, and (d) NOT running a broader scan that would also hit /workspace/vendor.
